facebook: What a Saturday at Old Lions Oval! 🦁 The 1st XI beat Kensington Ridge CC by 34 runs in Premier League Round 4, posting 268/7 after winning the toss and then bowling the visitors out for 234. Player of the match is Thabo Mokoena, who smashed 112 off 118 balls with 11 fours and 3 sixes, backed up by Sipho Ndlovu's 47, Aiden Naidoo's quickfire 31* off 22 and Musa Khumalo's 4 for 38. Well played to Kensington Ridge for a good contest!
